pages.text: Cars and trailers are put together at a $(item)Car Workbench$(). Right-click it: the buttons along the top are the vehicles it builds. Hover over one to see which parts you have; click it to put every part you carry into place. A green tick means you carry them all.
Slots laid out like the car from above; parts not fitted yet show as blue ghosts.

Every car takes a $(thing)chassis$(), a $(thing)body$(), an $(thing)interior$(), an engine and four tires; a motorcycle two tires. Diesel trucks take a $(item)Diesel Engine$(), motorcycles a $(item)Motorcycle Engine$() and electric cars an $(item)Electric Motor$(). A trailer takes the $(item)Trailer Chassis$(), its own body and four tires.$(br2)Parts left in the workbench go back to you when you close it. With $(thing)JEI$(), each vehicle has a recipe page too.
